boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten named, on-campus Manhattan University activities that the university says are offered to students for free.

cards.title: Festival of Lessons & Carols
cards.subtitle: Chapel of De La Salle and His Brothers
cards.notes: Plan to arrive early and attend the readings, orchestra performances, hymns, and candlelit prayer with friends.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel program of music, readings, and shared singing.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University lists Festival of Lessons & Carols in the Chapel of De La Salle and His Brothers; its catalog says all on-campus events are free to students.
cards.access_notes: For Manhattan University students; confirm the annual date and chapel details through the campus events calendar.

cards.title: Jasper Day of Wellness
cards.subtitle: Manhattan University campus
cards.notes: Use the full-day wellness program as a low-key way to pause, join activities, and make a plan with classmates.
cards.short_summary: A spring-semester campus day centered on mental and physical health.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University describes Jasper Day of Wellness as a full-day spring-semester event; its catalog says all on-campus events are free to students.
cards.access_notes: For Manhattan University students; check the campus events calendar for the current program and location.

cards.title: Latinx Fest
cards.subtitle: Great Room, Student Commons
cards.notes: Meet in the Great Room for the Hispanic Heritage Month celebration, with food, music, and dancing on campus.
cards.short_summary: A Student Commons celebration of Latino culture during Hispanic Heritage Month.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University says Latinx Fest is open to all students and takes place in the Student Commons Great Room; its catalog says all on-campus events are free to students.
cards.access_notes: Open to Manhattan University students; verify the current date and program with Student Engagement.

cards.title: Manhattan Madness
cards.subtitle: Draddy Gym
cards.notes: Go to the season-opening pep rally to watch basketball introductions alongside cheer, dance, and pep-band performances.
cards.short_summary: A Draddy Gym pep rally launching the Jaspers basketball season.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University identifies Manhattan Madness as an on-campus late-night pep rally in Draddy Gym; its catalog says all on-campus events are free to students.
cards.access_notes: For Manhattan University students; consult the campus events calendar for the current start time and entry details.

cards.title: Mission Month
cards.subtitle: Manhattan University campus, April
cards.notes: Choose a mission-focused session from the April program and attend with a friend to discuss the Lasallian theme afterward.
cards.short_summary: An April series highlighting Manhattan University's Lasallian mission.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University designates April as Mission Month and says more than 100 related events are promoted to the campus community; its catalog says all on-campus events are free to students.
cards.access_notes: For Manhattan University students; individual program locations and dates vary, so check the campus events calendar.

cards.title: Movies on the Quad
cards.subtitle: The Quad, Manhattan University
cards.notes: Bring a blanket and settle onto the Quad for a Friday-night outdoor screening during the fall semester.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor fall film screening series on the campus Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University says Movies on the Quad occurs on Friday nights during the fall semester on the Quad; its catalog says all on-campus events are free to students.
cards.access_notes: For Manhattan University students; check the campus events calendar for the film, weather plan, and screening time.

cards.title: Spring Concert
cards.subtitle: Draddy Gym and the Quad
cards.notes: Coordinate with friends for the concert, then use the surrounding Quad programming as a shared daytime campus hang.
cards.short_summary: A spring campus concert paired with Quad activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University describes Spring Concert as a campus event with a concert in Draddy Gym plus a barbecue and carnival on the Quad; its catalog says all on-campus events are free to students.
cards.access_notes: For Manhattan University students; confirm the current schedule, venue setup, and any activity details with Student Engagement.

cards.title: Student Engagement & Volunteer Fair
cards.subtitle: Manhattan University campus, start of each semester
cards.notes: Walk the information tables with a friend, ask clubs about upcoming meetings, and compare volunteer opportunities before joining.
cards.short_summary: A semester-start fair where campus groups recruit and answer questions.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University says the Student Engagement & Volunteer Fair is held at the beginning of each spring and fall semester; its catalog says all on-campus events are free to students.
cards.access_notes: For Manhattan University students; review the campus events calendar for the semester's fair location and time.

cards.title: Student Engagement Lecture Series
cards.subtitle: Manhattan University campus, fall
cards.notes: Attend a scheduled talk with classmates, then stay afterward to compare notes on the speaker’s ideas and questions.
cards.short_summary: A fall campus lecture series organized by Student Engagement.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University says Student Engagement organizes this fall lecture series on campus; its catalog says all on-campus events are free to students.
cards.access_notes: For Manhattan University students; speakers, dates, and locations are announced through the campus events calendar.

cards.title: Constitution Day
cards.subtitle: Manhattan University campus
cards.notes: Watch for the campus-wide Constitution Day program and invite classmates to attend the scheduled session together.
cards.short_summary: A campus-wide Student Engagement program named by the university.
cards.evidence_claim: Manhattan University's Student Engagement office lists Constitution Day among its campus-wide programs; its catalog says all on-campus events are free to students.
cards.source_title: Office of Student Engagement | Manhattan University
cards.access_notes: For Manhattan University students; check the campus events calendar for the current Constitution Day details.
